title: Crawl coverage
description: How much of the site a crawl reached. The source document every other document's confidence/derived_from/coverage_ref claims point at. See docs/adr/0001-coverage-schema-scope.md for what ships with real data in v1 vs. reserved for later.

run_id.description: Unique per crawl run; every coverage_ref in other documents cites this until module-level citation exists.

stopped_reason.description: Set when a budget cut the run short. Present iff generators/coverage.py's render_coverage_banner was given a stopped_reason.

unvisited.description: Every discovered-but-unfinished URL, with why. Real data today (generators/coverage.py's unfinished_urls); 'reason' beyond "unfinished" (auth_wall, captcha, etc.) is reserved until blocker detection exists.

endpoints.description: No known denominator for total API surface (per the format audit's own diagnosis) — observed is an absolute count; saturation_curve is the honest substitute for a percentage.

saturation_curve.description: New first-party endpoints per interaction bucket, computed from Interaction.step_seq joined to Endpoint via Request. A flattening curve signals high coverage even without a denominator.

roles.description: Reserved. Single anonymous role today (the crawler never signs in) — real multi-role data depends on issue #55 (stateful/immutable crawl modes) landing first.

blockers.description: Reserved, empty today. No blocker-type detection (login/captcha/2FA/paywall/destructive-action-guard) exists anywhere in the crawler yet.

module_coverage.description: Reserved, empty today. module_id must line up with whatever architecture/export (issue #72, blocked on #66) eventually define as a module — not invented here.
